subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• There are 15 National Marine Sanctuaries (NMS) in US coastal waters.
• Gray's Reef NMS covers 22 square miles off the coast of Georgia, on the Atlantic side.
• It was established in part to protect the endangered loggerhead sea turtle.
• Cordell Bank NMS covers 1,286 square miles off the coast of California, on the Pacific side.
• It was established in part to protect the endangered blue whale.
prompt: The student wants to provide an overview of the NMS program. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The US's 15 NMS protect endangered species in coastal waters from the Atlantic to the Pacific.
choices.B: Both Gray's Reef NMS and Cordell Bank NMS were established in part to protect endangered species.
choices.C: California's Cordell Bank NMS was established in part to protect the endangered blue whale.
choices.D: One of 15 NMS in US coastal waters, Gray's Reef NMS covers 22 square miles off the coast of Georgia.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. The sentence provides an overview of the NMS program, explaining that the US has 15 NMS and that these sanctuaries protect endangered species in coastal waters stretching from the Atlantic to the Pacific.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect. The sentence focuses on one specific sanctuary; it doesn't provide an overview of the NMS program as a whole.
